name: mirage-tracker-reminder
description: Mirage AEC Tracker Reminder - emails each person their drawings due today (8 PM IST) from any registered project tracker on SharePoint. Logic ported 1:1 from Excel_Notify.
//: * xlsx (SheetJS) is installed from SheetJS's own CDN, NOT the npm registry.
WHY: the npm registry copy stopped at 0.18.5, which has known security
advisories; SheetJS publishes fixed versions only on cdn.sheetjs.com.
* engines node>=20: GitHub Actions' current Node LTS; fetch() built in.
* WHY: core/*.js must run unchanged in the browser (admin page,
<script type=module>, no build step) AND in Node (nightly job).
Both understand ES modules (import/export); only Node understands
require(). Without this flag Node would reject the import syntax.

decide whether anything is really sent.
